map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. Your colleagues learn from every crash; Certification requires that you keep up.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls: walk into the red car's path and let it hit you.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Step into a colleague's path under the highway and let it hit you.
tiles.hint: Walk into its lane under the highway.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: Dash (Space): after one hit, it brakes for dummies in its lane.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. Once hit, your colleague learns to brake for dummies in its lane.
tiles.hint: Wait by the podium; Space dashes into its path.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: The drop: side sensors watch the kerb; fall from the Z2 deck.
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights the bend. Your colleague now watches the kerb, not the sky. Gravity is company policy.
tiles.hint: Escalator up; step off the Z2 parapet gap into its path.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Cover: roof lidar sees falls; spring from behind the portal tower.
tiles.tale: The highway runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Roof lidar is expensed: falling is now visible.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the portal tower; step out into its path.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras: watched cover stops hiding you; find the monument's blind side.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Street cameras report to your colleague.
tiles.hint: Hide behind the monument's far side from cameras; step into its path.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Cones (J): a cone in its lane makes it swerve into you.
tiles.tale: Neon shops sell nothing, yet traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
tiles.hint: J: put a cone in its lane; wait beside it.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: DUCK (hold C) behind low planters; cones stop working.
tiles.tale: DUCK is approved. The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time; their planters hide you the same way.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind a planter; spring into its path.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Crash memory: it watches every spot you were hit from.
tiles.tale: Legs 1 is fitted. Between the LED walls, your colleague now watches every spot it hit you from.
tiles.hint: Spring from a new wall each time; jump into its path.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: The Incident: white tailgaters rear-end the red car when it stops hard.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every driver for driving safely. Make the red car brake hard; traffic files the Incident.
tiles.hint: Spring from cover into its path; tailgaters do the rest.

rationale: Fixed the two labels to name the move. Cut the tile 3 override and shortened hints. Tile 5 drops to one hit as a breather; its camera range override softens the stage. Kept lungeGuide to help the first dash and duckNoticeFactor to soften the first planter test. Tile 8 now names the jump. Removed the cone-closure preview from the tile 7 tale.
